newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes ahead on dollar selling.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes ahead on dollar selling.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed stronger as high money rates prompted banks to sell dollars, dealers said.
The rupee ended at 56.80 to the dollar after opening at its previous closing level of 56.95.
"Banks continued to sell dollars to generate rupees because money rates remained high," said an American Express dealer.
The U.S. unit's fall was cushioned by a little import covering demand, he said.
